title: Cassette2Vec-EC: genomic-island cassette architecture for Enterococcus cecorum lineage classification
description: Code and data archive for Lagad RR, Rafi S, Goswami A (2026), Genomic-island cassette architecture provides interpretable signal for exploratory classification of poultry-associated Enterococcus cecorum lineages, Frontiers in Microbiology 17:1882753. Contains the v1.1 cassette-row pipeline: feature construction from IslandViewer and ABRicate output, AMR neighbourhood scoring, a trained XGBoost cassette-row model, and evaluation figures. The primary Random Forest model reported in the paper is not included in this version.
